ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE POLICE UNIFORMS AND EQUIPMENT REGULATION ACT — Attached Form No. 1 (revised December 31, 2020).
Online filing: minwon.police.go.kr. Mark √ in applicable [ ] boxes. FRONT.
APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION / CHANGE OF REGISTRATION OF MANUFACTURING OR SALES BUSINESS
Subject: [ ] Police uniforms [ ] Police equipment. Type: [ ] Registration [ ] Change registration.
Receipt No.: ______  Date received: ______  Processing time: 30 days.
Applicant (corporation: representative): Name ______; resident registration No. (foreign registration No.) ______; address ______; telephone ______.
Business: trade or corporate name ______; business registration No. ______; location ______; telephone ______.
NEW REGISTRATION — detailed categories of items requested: __________________.
CHANGE REGISTRATION — before ______; after ______; reason ______.
Under Article 3 (1) of the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act and Articles 3 and 4 of its Enforcement Decree, I apply for [ ] registration [ ] change registration of:
[ ] police uniform manufacture [ ] police uniform sales [ ] police equipment manufacture [ ] police equipment sales.
Year ____ Month ____ Day ____. Applicant/representative: ______ (signature or seal).
To the Head of City/Do Police Agency; Head of ○○ Regional Coast Guard; Commander of Autonomous Police Corps.
Attachments: see reverse. Fee: none. Paper: 210 mm × 297 mm (woodfree or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²).
REVERSE — Applicant's documents: 1. Manufacture: direct production certificate or other proof of direct production. 2. Sales: facility drawings or proof of sales floor area. 3. List of executives (corporations only). 4. Proof of registered changes (change applications only). Fee: none.
Official verifies: 1. Extract of resident registration record. 2. Corporate registration certificate (corporations only). 3. Certificate of foreign registration (foreigners only).
CONSENT TO JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION: I consent to the official checking items 1 and 3 above via the shared administrative information system pursuant to Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act. If I do not consent, I must submit the documents myself.
Applicant/representative: ______ (signature or seal).
Procedure: prepare application → receive → verify → approve → prepare registration certificate → issue registration certificate. Applicant first; competent police authority at all subsequent stages.
